levels.note: Employment News is a government newspaper aggregating job notifications from central and state govt.

reality: Employment News is a government publication. It is not a recruiting portal itself but an aggregator.
Jobs listed there are mostly from the last 7 days to 1 year old.
Treat Employment News posts as historical references, not current notifications.

faq.q: Is Employment News a recruiting portal?
faq.a: No. Employment News is a government newspaper that publishes job listings. It is an aggregator source, not a primary recruiting board.

faq.q: Which jobs are listed in Employment News?
faq.a: Various government jobs from central and state governments — Railways, SSC, UPSC, State PSCs, PSU jobs, etc. across all categories.

faq.q: Can I find current government jobs in Employment News?
faq.a: No. Employment News is a weekly publication. For current jobs, use the primary recruiting portals (see /all-jobs.html).
